label: Wan 2.2 Animate 14B
description: Pose + face driven character animation: keeps your reference identity while copying the body and facial motion of the driving clip. Highest fidelity, heaviest on VRAM - designed for 14B fp8/GGUF on a T4 with ComfyUI's low-VRAM mode.
notes: Needs ~10 GB upload + ComfyUI lowvram. Expect 12-25 min for a 4 s 480p clip on a free T4. If preflight reports missing nodes, either update ComfyUI or use the wan21-vace engine.
